user.title: Connect Longse NVR/DVR
user.description: Enter the connection details for your NVR/DVR (web panel/API, port 80).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Check the IP address and port.
error.unsupported_device: The device responded, but it does not appear to be a compatible Longse/BitVision NVR (missing or unexpected API response).

init.title: Longse NVR/DVR options
init.description: Choose the RTSP stream used for live view and snapshots. Main is recommended (more reliable); Sub is more prone to occasional corrupted frames on this device family.
